newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Drought area reduced in Australia's NSW state.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Drought area reduced in Australia's NSW state.

text.p: A reduction in the state's drought declared area in October was good news for the economy of New South Wales, state Agriculture Minister Richard Amery said.

With 22 percent of the state now drought-declared, down from 29 percent last month, the state had the lowest level of drought since February this year when 28 percent of the state was in drought, he said.
Further good rain in October together with mild conditions had ensured good pasture growth over much of the tablelands and slopes, he said.
The harvest of winter cereals had started in the west and northwest with excellent yields and quality reported, he said.
Above-average yields from an estimated four million hectares of winter cereals could be worth as nmuch as A$1 billion to the state's economy, he said.
